'''Marcus Wood Who Said Artoo Wasn't Key?''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Marcus Wood]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls115.htm Who Said Artoo Wasn't Key?], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010112054000/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls115.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
